routes.title: The Plate Handoff Test
routes.universal_truth: Marriage does not remove tiny chores; it makes tiny chore negotiations funnier.
routes.proof_beat: He hands over his plate. She stacks hers on top.
routes.partner_roles: He tries the shortcut. She catches it and upgrades it. He accepts defeat and takes both plates.

routes.title: Two Lazy People, One Kitchen
routes.universal_truth: Some married couples are not divided into helpful and helpless; both are just trying not to get up.
routes.proof_beat: Each person tries to make the other carry the plates.
routes.partner_roles: Both negotiate through body language instead of speeches.

routes.title: Room Service Was Closed
routes.universal_truth: Newly married people secretly test what marriage privileges they now have.
routes.proof_beat: He offers his plate like room service exists; she returns a bigger order.
routes.partner_roles: She refuses servant framing through a comic reversal.
routes.repair_note: Funny but too close to wife-as-service unless softened into mutual laziness.

routes.title: The Silent Counterattack
routes.universal_truth: Some partners do not argue; they answer with better timing.
routes.proof_beat: She says nothing, just adds her plate.
routes.partner_roles: Her silence is the joke; his kitchen walk is the consequence.
routes.repair_note: Strong visual reversal, but alone it can become wife-wins/husband-loses instead of shared comfort.

routes.title: He Got Promoted
routes.universal_truth: Marriage has promotions nobody applies for.
routes.proof_beat: He thinks he promoted himself; the plate stack promotes him to kitchen department.
routes.partner_roles: He starts smug, she stays deadpan, he becomes lightly defeated.
routes.repair_note: Keep 'promoted' as a caption spice, not the whole slide spine.

routes.title: Wife Privileges Expired Immediately
routes.universal_truth: Some marriage assumptions last exactly one second.
routes.proof_beat: He tries to use wife privilege; she cancels it instantly.
routes.repair_note: Too risky and too phrase-dependent; can sound like endorsing wife service before the reversal lands.

routes.title: Shared Plate Duty
routes.universal_truth: The smallest tasks reveal the real rhythm of a home.
routes.proof_beat: Two dinner plates become the night's negotiation.
routes.repair_note: Too close to chore fairness content and not funny enough.

routes.title: The Kitchen Was Far
routes.universal_truth: After dinner, the kitchen somehow becomes the farthest place in the house.
routes.proof_beat: He looks at the kitchen, looks at wife, tries the handoff.
routes.partner_roles: Both understand the lazy math immediately.

selector_verdict: Select R1 because it preserves the creator's original scene, has the clearest physical reversal, avoids perfect-husband praise, and gives viewers an immediate 'this is us after dinner' send reason.
excluded_memory_lanes: same-old Aachu chaos -> Zuv handler pattern
